BiblicalUsage: This is the word for a foundation, and it shows up only once, in the judgment on Babylon. Her foundations are fallen, her walls thrown down, because the vengeance of the LORD has come on her.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that no foundation built against God stands, and Babylon's fall is the proof.
